settings.instructions: Instagram Graph API server based on https://github.com/mcpware/instagram-mcp, Graph v26.0 and Facebook Login. Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page required. Use get_account_pages then get_instagram_account to discover IDs. Configure Meta app OAuth; scopes instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, instagram_manage_insights, instagram_manage_comments, pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, instagram_manage_messages and pages_manage_metadata. Messaging permissions may require App Review/Advanced Access; if messaging is not needed, omit its last two scopes. Publish an image or Reel with create_media_container, poll get_media_container_status until FINISHED, then publish_media with creation_id. Reels use media_type REELS. Carousels: create 2-10 child containers with is_carousel_item true, create_carousel_container from IDs, poll and publish the parent. These workflows cover reference publish_media/publish_reel/publish_carousel through multiple tools, not one-call wrappers. Comment writes are post_comment, reply_to_comment, hide_comment and delete_comment. get_mentions lists tagged media only. Require explicit intent for publishing, messaging and moderation. Inactive messaging tools require a Page access token, not the broker's standard User token; get_conversations and send_dm take linked Facebook page_id. The generic OAuth broker cannot currently select Page tokens per tool. Keep messaging tools inactive until Page-token mode is configured. No static Page-token override is installed. Page-token overrides would apply to all tools on this server. Never expose tokens through tool results. Meta token expiry can require reconnecting.

tools.name: get_account_pages
tools.description: Read Facebook Pages connected to the current user and linked Instagram professional accounts. Uses a Facebook User token; excludes Page access tokens from the response.

tools.name: get_instagram_account
tools.description: Read the Instagram professional account linked to a known Facebook Page.

page_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_profile_info
tools.description: Read Instagram professional account profile and follower/media counts.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_media_posts
tools.description: Read recent Instagram media and basic engagement counts. Paginate with after.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_media_details
tools.description: Read one owned Instagram media object.

media_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_media_insights
tools.description: Read insights for owned Instagram media. metric is comma-separated and must match the media type and current Graph version; do not use removed impressions/plays metrics.

media_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_account_insights
tools.description: Read account-level insights. Select current supported metrics and their required metric_type, period and breakdown; timestamps are UTC.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: validate_access_token
tools.description: Harmless authenticated identity read to verify the current token works. Does not expose the access token or prove every permission.

tools.name: get_content_publishing_limit
tools.description: Read the current publishing quota and usage from Meta. Do not hardcode historic limits.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Read comments and replies on owned Instagram media.

media_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_comment_replies
tools.description: Read replies to one Instagram comment.

comment_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: Read currently available Instagram stories.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_mentions
tools.description: Read media where the Instagram professional account has been tagged, using the Graph /tags edge. This matches the reference implementation's tagged-media operation; it does not enumerate every caption or comment @mention.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: business_discovery
tools.description: Read public metadata and media for another professional Instagram account through Business Discovery; no personal or age-gated accounts.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: search_hashtag
tools.description: Read the ID of a hashtag; requires approved Instagram Public Content Access. Meta counts unique searched hashtags against its rolling quota.

user_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_hashtag_media
tools.description: Read top or recent public hashtag media; requires Instagram Public Content Access.

hashtag_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

user_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_conversations
tools.description: Read Instagram messaging conversations. Requires reviewed messaging permissions and an appropriate Page access token; per-user Facebook OAuth alone may not satisfy this endpoint.

page_id.description: Linked Facebook Page ID, not the Instagram account ID.

tools.name: get_conversation_messages
tools.description: Read the messages field of an Instagram conversation with a Page access token and approved messaging permissions. Returns nested messages data and its pagination. Configure Page-token authentication before activating this inactive tool.

fields.description: Graph fields expression. To paginate nested messages, request messages.limit(25).after(CURSOR){id,created_time,from,to,message}; use the returned messages.paging cursor.

tools.name: create_media_container
tools.description: Create an unpublished Instagram image, Reel, story, or carousel-child container. This is a write. Provide exactly one image_url or video_url. For VIDEO/REELS wait until container status FINISHED before publishing. For carousel children set is_carousel_item:true. URLs must be publicly fetchable and meet Meta media requirements.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

media_type.description: Omit for images; use VIDEO only for carousel video children.

location_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: create_carousel_container
tools.description: Create an unpublished carousel from previously created and ready child container IDs. This is a write. Publish using publish_media only after explicit approval.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

items.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

location_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: get_media_container_status
tools.description: Read container processing status. Publish only after FINISHED; ERROR/EXPIRED requires investigation.

container_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: publish_media
tools.description: Publish a ready Instagram media or carousel container to the real account. Requires explicit user authorization for this exact post. Wait for FINISHED first; independently read published media afterwards.

account_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

creation_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Post a real comment on owned Instagram media. Requires explicit authorization for the exact text and target.

media_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a real reply to an Instagram comment. Requires explicit authorization for the exact text and target.

comment_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: hide_comment
tools.description: Hide or unhide an Instagram comment. Requires explicit authorization for moderation.

comment_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete an Instagram comment. Irreversible write; requires explicit authorization for the exact comment.

comment_id.description: Real numeric ID returned by the API

tools.name: send_dm
tools.description: Send a real Instagram text message via its linked Facebook Page using a Page access token. Requires instagram_manage_messages with the appropriate access level; recipient must have initiated the conversation and be within the permitted response window. Text must be 1000 UTF-8 bytes or less. Requires explicit intent for the exact recipient and text. Configure a Page-token authentication flow before activating this inactive tool.

page_id.description: Facebook Page ID linked to the Instagram account; not the Instagram account ID.

excluded.reason: Stored credentials are encrypted with a key unique to the site that saved them, so they cannot be restored elsewhere. Re-enter them after importing.
